step.cmd: Fact-find with the client to obtain an acceptable medical certificate:

ul.li: Explain to the client why the medical certificate submitted is not acceptable.
Ask the client to submit a new acceptable medical certificate.

step.cmd: Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 6.
If the client was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to Unacceptable medical certificate . Unacceptable medical certificate

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
